w1.title: Worked Example 1: Perimeter & Area of Rectangles and Squares
w1.question: An Eco Seva garden bed is 8 m long and 5 m wide. Find its fencing perimeter and soil area.

steps.text: The bed needs 26 m of boundary fencing and covers 40 m².

check.q: If a rectangular plot has length 10 m and breadth 4 m, what is its perimeter?

opts.m: 40 m² is the area (l × b), not the boundary perimeter.
14 m is only l + b; double it for all four sides.

w2.title: Worked Example 2: Area of Parallelograms & Triangles
w2.question: Find the area of a triangular solar-panel support frame with base 6 m and height 4 m.

steps.text: Identify base b = 6 m and perpendicular height h = 4 m.
Apply the triangle area formula: A = ½ × b × h.

check.q: What is the area of a parallelogram with base 9 cm and perpendicular height 5 cm?

opts.m: Do not divide by 2 for a parallelogram; ½ × b × h is for triangles.

w3.title: Worked Example 3: Circumference & Area of Circular Water Tanks
w3.question: Find the circumference of a circular tank cover of radius 7 m (use π = 22/7).

steps.text: Write the circumference formula: C = 2 × π × r.
Substitute r = 7 m and π = 22/7: C = 2 × (22/7) × 7.

check.q: If the radius of a circle doubles, how does its area change?

opts.m: Area depends on r², so doubling r multiplies area by 2².
Area scales with the square of the radius.

NODES.title: Perimeter & Area of Rectangles and Squares

steps.title: Perimeter & Area of Rectangles and Squares
steps.body: Perimeter is the total boundary distance around a closed figure (P = 2(l + b)), while area measures the surface enclosed inside (A = l × b).

14 m is only l + b; double it for all four sides.

steps.title: Area of Parallelograms & Triangles
steps.body: Every parallelogram with base b and perpendicular height h has area A = b × h, and a triangle with the same base and height has half that area: A = ½ × b × h.

NODES.title: Circumference & Area of Circular Water Tanks

steps.title: Circumference & Area of Circular Water Tanks
steps.body: For a circle of radius r, the circumference is C = 2πr and the enclosed area is A = πr² (where π ≈ 22/7).
